column4: 謙信が目を覚ます、身体はまだ痛い
column5: Kenshin wakes up; his body still aches.

column4: 戦いはどうなった、奴らはまだ近くにいるのか・・と愛に聞く
column5: He asks Ai, 'What happened with the battle? Are they still nearby?'

column4: 昨夜はギリギリの所でランス様に救われかろうじて脱出した、ルメイ焼却部隊は
column5: Ai replies, 'Last night, we were saved by Rance-sama at the last moment and barely escaped. The LeMay Incineration Unit...'

column4: まだ近くにいるが、我々も消耗も激しく戦える状態では無い、特に謙信様が・・
column5: '...is still nearby, but we are severely exhausted and not in fighting condition, especially Lord Kenshin...'

column4: 私は大丈夫だと、元気だ・・それよりあの外道部隊を生かしておく訳にはいかないと
column5: Kenshin insists, 'I'm fine, I'm strong... More importantly, we can't leave that fiendish unit alive.'

column4: 無理して出撃しようとする
column5: He attempts to force himself to sortie.

column4: そこらランスが現れる、謙信ちゃん起きたか・・
column5: At that moment, Rance appears, 'Kenshin-chan, you're awake...'

column4: なに、出撃するだと・・元気だから大丈夫だ心配無用だと・・
column5: 'What, you're going to sortie? You say you're fine and there's no need to worry...'

column4: いいだろう、ただし俺と今からセックスしてからだ
column5: 'Fine, but only after you have sex with me right now.'

column4: 俺はお前達を助けた、御褒美がほしい、それに戦うの鋭気を養うために謙信が抱きたい
column5: 'I helped you all; I want a reward, and moreover, Kenshin, I want to hold you to regain your fighting spirit.'

column4: 惚れた弱み・・わかった・・、ただしすぐに戦いに出たいから早い目で頼む
column5: 'It's your charm weakness... I understand. But I want to go into battle quickly, so please be quick about it.'

column4: 少し激しくやります、気絶する謙信
column5: (They do it a bit more intensely, Kenshin faints.)

column4: ランスは愛に謙信を預け、出かけます。
column5: Rance entrusts Kenshin to Ai and sets out.
